card_semantics: STAGE/STAGE_BATCH cards carry their own levels. HOLD/DELETE/MODIFY cards carry the levels of the order they act upon in meta.evaluates and are audited by an internal STAGE probe, so a resting limit faces the identical gate set as a fresh one. WATCH cards carry an armed trigger and are not evaluated for geometry.
